criteria.text: The chat composer grows taller as the user types multi-line text.
criteria.test_id: issue-1280-c1: multiline typing delegates height growth to native layout without a synthetic content-size event

criteria.text: The chat composer keeps intrinsic multiline growth to an 84pt input cap, then scrolls internally, while the keyboard-visible stack stays within 56pt without attachments, 104pt with one or two attachments, and 148pt with attachments plus a maximum draft.
criteria.test_id: issue-1280-c2: a long draft keeps the intrinsic dock cap and native scrolling without a synthetic content-size event
criteria.reason: The executable contract verifies the intrinsic 84pt input cap and native scrolling; focused composer geometry assertions verify the keyboard-visible 56pt, 104pt, and 148pt stack limits.

criteria.text: A human must confirm on a real iPhone before this is called done.
criteria.reason: Requires signed physical iPhone smoke covering multiline typing and paste growth, shrink after deletion/clear, and keyboard-visible 56pt/104pt/148pt stack geometry.
